title: Adaptive grid visual regression and touch interaction buglog
creator: Lena Brooks
description: Runbook and active buglog for cross-browser responsive QA focused on adaptive grid behavior, spacing tokens, interactive controls (buttons, tooltips), table layouts, and chart touch interactions. The goal is to (1) catalog reproducible visual and interaction regressions across Safari (iOS/macOS), Firefox (desktop/mobile), and Android Chrome; (2) decide component vs token fixes; and (3) land targeted PRs plus visual test baselines. This ticket coordinates Design + QA + Frontend to clear high-severity regressions blocking the ui-kit-2026.03 release.
acceptance_criteria: Top 8 regressions reproduced with deterministic steps and screenshots for each browser/viewport
Component-level fixes proposed or PRs opened for each regression
Visual regression baselines updated and Percy/Chromatic run shows no unexpected diffs for fixed items
Follow-up work created for remaining medium/low issues with owners and estimates
test_matrix: Desktop: macOS 13 Safari 16, Firefox 115, Chrome 110 at 1366x768 and 1280x800
Mobile: iPhone 14 Safari (portrait/landscape) at 390x844, iPad Safari at 820x1180
Android: Pixel 6 Chrome and Firefox Preview in portrait/landscape at 412x915
Viewport breakpoints: 320, 375, 412, 768, 1024; test component states (default, compact tokens, dense tokens)
Assistive tech: VoiceOver iOS basic smoke for button focus and table headers
bug_entries: DES-BUG-001 | Severity: high | Component: Buttons (primary) | Symptom: drop-shadow clipped when button inside overflow:auto container on iOS Safari 16 (macOS and iOS) causing visible cut-off at edge | Repro steps: 1) Open /storybook/button in Stripe layout; 2) Resize to 375px and add overflow demo container; 3) Observe shadow clipped on right edge | Status: Open | Owner: Miguel Hernandez | PR: github.com/redwood-inference/ui-kit/pull/492 | Screenshot: drive.google.com/drive/folders/ui-kit-bugs/button-shadow-ios.png

DES-BUG-002 | Severity: P0 | Component: Tokens (spacing-compact) | Symptom: table cell truncation and overlapping text at 375px in Firefox mobile view when token set = spacing-compact; Chrome shows correct wrap | Repro steps: 1) Set token preset to 'compact' in theme switcher; 2) Open /components/table with long cell content; 3) Resize to 375 width in Firefox mobile simulation; 4) Observe overflow without ellipsis | Status: In Review | Owner: Ayesha Kapoor (design owner) | PR: github.com/redwood-inference/ui-kit/pull/501 | Screenshot: drive.google.com/drive/folders/ui-kit-bugs/tokens-table-firefox-375.png

DES-BUG-003 | Severity: medium | Component: Charts (line chart tooltip) | Symptom: tooltip flicker and stuck state on touch devices when panning on both Android Chrome and iOS Safari; appears after rapid swipe and does not hide until second tap | Repro steps: 1) Open /examples/charts/interactive-line; 2) On mobile, pan horizontally; 3) Rapidly release finger -> tooltip persists or flickers | Status: Open | Owner: Ravi Patel | Linked Issue: ENG-2892 | Screenshot/GIF: drive.google.com/drive/folders/ui-kit-bugs/charts-tooltip-touch.gif

DES-BUG-004 | Severity: medium | Component: Tables (sticky header) | Symptom: sticky header becomes pixel misaligned when horizontal scrollbar present in Firefox desktop leading to 1-2px shift vs Chrome; visual regression shows header border gap | Repro steps: 1) Open /components/table with many columns; 2) Force horizontal overflow on Firefox; 3) Scroll horizontally and compare header alignment with body | Status: Open | Owner: Miguel Hernandez | PR: github.com/redwood-inference/ui-kit/pull/495 | Screenshot: drive.google.com/drive/folders/ui-kit-bugs/table-sticky-firefox.png

DES-BUG-005 | Severity: low | Component: Buttons (touch target) | Symptom: rounded icon-only buttons on iOS Safari reduce hit area when border-radius combined with overflow:hidden on parent card; failed VoiceOver target area | Repro steps: 1) Use icon-button in card with overflow hidden and border-radius 12px; 2) Inspect touch area using Accessibility Inspector on iOS; 3) Observe reduced hit target | Status: Backlog | Owner: Unassigned | Follow-up: accessibility audit task

DES-BUG-006 | Severity: medium | Component: Tokens (font-scaling) | Symptom: 'ui-heading' token scales differently in Firefox zoom 125% causing line-height collapse in multi-line labels for tables and chip components | Repro steps: 1) Set browser zoom to 125% in Firefox; 2) Open /components/chip and /components/table; 3) Observe clipping and overlapping text | Status: In Progress | Owner: Lena Brooks | PR: github.com/redwood-inference/ui-kit/pull/506 | Screenshot: drive.google.com/drive/folders/ui-kit-bugs/font-zoom-firefox.png

DES-BUG-007 | Severity: high | Component: Charts (SVG clipping) | Symptom: axis labels truncated near right edge in Safari when container uses transform: translateZ(0) for GPU acceleration; reproduces on macOS Safari and certain iPad configurations | Repro steps: 1) Open /examples/charts/responsive-area; 2) Toggle GPU acceleration demo; 3) Resize artboard to 1024x768; 4) Inspect rightmost labels | Status: Open | Owner: Miguel Hernandez | PR: TBD | Screenshot: drive.google.com/drive/folders/ui-kit-bugs/charts-axis-safari.png
decisions: Prefer component-level fixes for interaction regressions that affect behavior (tooltips, touch targets) to avoid global token churn
Introduce a 'safe-shadow' wrapper utility to avoid overflow clipping on iOS instead of changing token semantics
For spacing-token truncation edge cases, add a compact-table variant and a responsive ellipsis behavior rather than changing global spacing tokens
Add temporary per-component visual regression exemptions for known flaky Playwright snapshots while we stabilize CSS; do not merge baseline changes without design sign-off
